nphi.title: AMR-EFFECT – RKI support strategy for implementing global AMR commitments (GHPP)
nphi.with: WHO HQ AMR Department; WHO EURO AMR Division (partner-country institutes not named)
nphi.summary: A GHPP project to help partner countries analyse AMR and healthcare-associated infection surveillance data and use them for policy, with a focus on digital tools and One Health approaches.

nphi.title: SMILE – Strengthening mobile laboratory capacities for health emergencies
nphi.with: Centre Hospitalier et Universitaire de Bouaké (Côte d'Ivoire); Johanniter-Unfall-Hilfe e.V. (Germany); Bernhard-Nocht-Institut für Tropenmedizin (Germany)
nphi.summary: Builds mobile laboratory capacity for emergency response in Côte d'Ivoire and The Gambia, including staff training, interoperability with Emergency Medical Teams and a West African mobile lab network.

nphi.title: PAcCIR – Public Health Actions for Côte d'Ivoire – Research
nphi.with: Centre Hospitalier et Universitaire de Bouaké (Côte d'Ivoire); Transformation for Development Institute (T4DI), Bouaké (Côte d'Ivoire); Helmholtz Institute for One Health, Greifswald (Germany)
nphi.summary: Research-focused follow-up strengthening genomic and AMR surveillance, One Health research, a regional AMR reference centre and surgical site infection prevention in Côte d'Ivoire, with an MSc programme.

nphi.title: SINCEP-Africa – Institutional networks and capacity for epidemiological preparedness in Africa
nphi.with: Institut National de Santé Publique (INSP) Côte d'Ivoire; Ghana Health Service; Liverpool School of Tropical Medicine; PANDORA platform (France); Fundação Manhiça; Ifakara Health Institute; Makerere University; Université de Kinshasa; CNRST-IRSS; Universidad de Navarra; CTI Africa
nphi.type: Network (Global Health EDCTP3 network of excellence)
nphi.summary: Global Health EDCTP3 coordination action turning INDEPTH community-based health surveillance sites into trial-ready sites for outbreaks, with Côte d'Ivoire's INSP hosting a new site.

nphi.title: EBO-PEP – Ebola Zaire post-exposure prophylaxis preparedness and efficacy evaluation
nphi.with: INSERM (coordinator); Agence Nationale de Sécurité Sanitaire (ANSS) Guinea; ALIMA; PANDEMIC platform; ISGlobal; Université de Bordeaux; PAC-CI; Université Gamal Abdel Nasser de Conakry; UCAD; MSF Belgium
nphi.summary: Global Health EDCTP3 trial led scientifically by DRC's INRB with Guinea's national health security agency ANSS, testing monoclonal antibodies as post-exposure prophylaxis for Ebola contacts and building rapid-trial infrastructure.

nphi.title: JICA–NMIMR Third Country Training Programme for African national laboratories
nphi.with: Noguchi Memorial Institute for Medical Research (NMIMR); national laboratory staff of West and Central African countries
nphi.summary: A JICA-funded laboratory training series hosted by Ghana's Noguchi Memorial Institute, launched after the West Africa Ebola outbreak, training national laboratory professionals from West, Central and Southern African countries in…

nphi.title: CDC Côte d'Ivoire country office
nphi.with: Ministry of Health, Public Hygiene and Universal Health Coverage; Institut National d'Hygiène Publique (INHP); Institut Pasteur de Côte d'Ivoire; National Malaria Control Program; Côte d'Ivoire FETP
nphi.summary: CDC's Côte d'Ivoire office (1987) works with the health ministry, INHP and Institut Pasteur on surveillance, lab accreditation, FETP and emergency response, plus HIV/TB, malaria, immunization and influenza.

nphi.title: Pasteur Network (Institut Pasteur International Network)
nphi.with: Pasteur Network members incl. Institut Pasteur de Dakar, de Bangui, de Côte d'Ivoire, de Guinée, du Maroc, de Madagascar, de Tunis, d'Algérie, du Cambodge, du Laos, Korea, Montevideo, São Paulo; Centre Pasteur du Cameroun; CERMES Niger; Fiocruz; NIHE, Pasteur Institutes Nha Trang and Ho Chi Minh City; Pasteur Institute of Iran; HKU-Pasteur Research Pole; Sciensano; Stephan Angeloff Institute; Hellenic Pasteur Institute; Institut Pasteur in Saint Petersburg
nphi.summary: Global network of about 33 public health and research institutes in 25 countries and territories, many of them national reference laboratories or NPHIs, collaborating on infectious disease surveillance, research and training.

nphi.title: EPIC – genomic surveillance capacity in five African countries (RKI/WHO Hub, with IGS Summer School)
nphi.with: WHO Hub for Pandemic and Epidemic Intelligence; national partner institutions in the five countries
nphi.summary: RKI's WHO Hub Office builds pathogen sequencing and genomic surveillance capacity in five African countries, including a two-week ZIG-IGS Summer School using fictional outbreak exercises and promoting South-South networking.

nphi.title: Regional Lassa fever preparedness simulation exercises in Benin and Liberia
nphi.with: IANPHI; African Field Epidemiology Network (AFENET); Integrated Quality Laboratory Services; Resolve to Save Lives; national public health institutes and ministries of 15 West African countries
nphi.summary: Two CDC-led regional simulation exercises (Cotonou and Monrovia, May 2026) with 30 participants from 15 West African countries testing cross-border coordination, surveillance, laboratory systems and outbreak response, followed by 7-1-7…

nphi.title: SLMTA training-of-trainers workshops for West African laboratory professionals
nphi.with: US CDC and CDC country offices; national public health laboratories and institutes; veterinary laboratories
nphi.summary: Two regional Strengthening Laboratory Management Toward Accreditation training-of-trainers workshops (Monrovia and Saly, April–May 2026) trained 40 laboratory professionals from 15 countries to build a regional quality and accreditation…

nphi.title: West Africa NPHI acceleration workshop (WAHO, Africa CDC, NCDC, US CDC, IANPHI)
nphi.with: Africa CDC; NCDC Nigeria; US CDC; IANPHI; NPHIs and ministries of 13 ECOWAS countries
nphi.summary: March 2024 workshop in Abuja where established, recent and nascent West African NPHIs shared lessons and drafted stage-appropriate action plans for establishing or strengthening their institutes, with requested partner support.

nphi.title: PAcCI – Public Health Actions for Côte d'Ivoire
nphi.with: CHU Bouaké; Université Alassane Ouattara; Helmholtz Institute for One Health
nphi.summary: Capacity building in infectious disease surveillance and prevention: digital tools, infection control, laboratory diagnostics, One Health and outbreak management.

nphi.title: Côte d'Ivoire public health bulletin and Francophone bulletin exchange
nphi.actor: Institut National de Santé Publique (INSP) Côte d'Ivoire
nphi.with: NPHIs of Burkina Faso, DRC and Mali; WAHO; US CDC; IANPHI; TEPHINET
nphi.summary: INSP Côte d'Ivoire launched its public health bulletin (BSP-CI) in April 2023 with CDC/IANPHI support. In August 2024 it hosted a Francophone peer exchange workshop in Abidjan on bulletins with Burkina Faso, DRC and Mali.

nphi.title: TB-COVID – COVID-19 impact on TB programmes in West and Central Africa
nphi.with: WHO Global TB Programme; WHO/TDR; WARN-TB/CARN-TB; HISP, University of Oslo (Norway)
nphi.summary: Built NTP capacity to monitor and mitigate COVID-19 disruption to TB services via a framework, DHIS2 package and preparedness plans.

nphi.title: BCHW – Corona Global – COVID-19 burden among health care workers
nphi.with: Nigeria Centre for Disease Control; National Veterinary Research Institute (Nigeria); Laboratoire d'Analyse Médicale Malagasy (Madagascar); CHU Bouaké (Côte d'Ivoire); INRB (DR Congo); Friedrich-Loeffler-Institut (Germany)
nphi.summary: Multisite study of HCW infection, vaccine effectiveness and risk factors, with a One Health module.

nphi.title: First virtual Staged Development Tool workshop with INSP Côte d'Ivoire
nphi.with: Institut National de Santé Publique (INSP) Côte d'Ivoire; US CDC
nphi.summary: IANPHI and US CDC facilitators ran a virtual Staged Development Tool workshop with INSP in September 2020 to assess research functions and set priorities such as strategic plan updates and mentoring.

nphi.title: PASQUALE – Partnership to improve patient safety and quality of care
nphi.with: Hôpital Régional de Faranah (Guinea); CHU Bouaké (Côte d'Ivoire)
nphi.summary: Hand hygiene then safe surgery improvements in partner hospitals following WHO patient safety challenges.

nphi.title: ALERRT – African coaLition for Epidemic Research, Response and Training
nphi.with: Institut National de Recherche Biomédicale (INRB); Uganda National Health Research Organisation; Institut Pasteur; Institut Pasteur de Dakar; Institut Pasteur de Côte d'Ivoire; Institut Pasteur de Bangui; Institut Pasteur de Madagascar; Centre Pasteur du Cameroun; Bernhard-Nocht-Institut; ITM Antwerp; KNUST; ALIMA
nphi.summary: EDCTP2-funded network building clinical research capacity to respond rapidly to epidemics in sub-Saharan Africa. Partners include national biomedical/public health institutes (INRB, UNHRO) and the Institut Pasteur network.

nphi.title: Annual West and Central Africa surveillance and health information systems workshop (Dakar, 2020)
nphi.with: US CDC (Atlanta and Senegal offices); WHO; HISP West and Central Africa
nphi.summary: Fourth annual IANPHI–US CDC technical workshop (Dakar, March 2020) where seven Francophone African countries shared experience on surveillance data use, DHIS2 roll-out, One Health zoonoses assessment and community event-based surveillance.

nphi.title: TRICE – Training on investigation and control of epidemics
nphi.with: Centre Muraz; CHU Sourô Sanou (Burkina Faso); CHU Bouaké; Université Alassane Ouattara; LANADA (Côte d'Ivoire); INRB; Kinshasa University Hospital (DR Congo); NICD; University of Pretoria (South Africa)

nphi.title: PPE – Partnership in postgraduate education
nphi.with: Centre Muraz (Burkina Faso); CHU Bouaké (Côte d'Ivoire); Kinshasa University Hospital (DR Congo); LAUTECH, NCDC, Obafemi Awolowo University, University of Ibadan (Nigeria); Naval Hospital Medical Center (Peru); Epidemiology Bureau DOH (Philippines); University of Pretoria (South Africa); Colombo Teaching Hospital Ragama (Sri Lanka); Central Laboratory (Sudan); Avicenna Tajik State Medical University (Tajikistan); Charles Nicolle Hospital (Tunisia)
nphi.summary: Train-the-trainer postgraduate stays at RKI in lab diagnostics and epidemiology for partner-country scientists.

nphi.title: ARGOS – Antimicrobial resistance global surveillance
nphi.with: CHU Bouaké (Côte d'Ivoire); Centre Muraz; CHU Sourô Sanou (Burkina Faso)
nphi.summary: Installed blood culture diagnostics and sentinel AMR surveillance in African hospitals.

nphi.title: EU CBRN CoE Project 048 – Improved regional management of outbreaks in the African Atlantic Façade
nphi.with: Expertise France; Institut Pasteur; Fondation Mérieux; IRD; French Ministry of Health; CNCMFE NRBC-E; FIIAPP
nphi.summary: EU-funded project in which Santé publique France, Institut Pasteur and other French and Spanish bodies built outbreak preparedness and rapid-response teams in 11 West and Central African countries after the Ebola epidemic.

nphi.title: IANPHI Ebola preparedness support to West and Central African countries
nphi.summary: In 2014–2015, IANPHI and its members gave funds and technical help to Guinea, Cameroon, Côte d'Ivoire and Guinea-Bissau. The help covered case-management training, prevention messages, protective equipment, specimen handling, screening at…

nphi.title: INSP–IRD framework agreement on scientific and technical cooperation
nphi.actor: Institut National de Santé Publique (INSP) Côte d'Ivoire
nphi.with: Institut de recherche pour le développement (IRD); Institut Pierre Richet (Bouaké)
nphi.summary: Framework agreement to strengthen research capacity at the Institut Pierre Richet in Bouaké against vector-borne diseases. INSP asked for the scope to be extended to nutrition, maternal and child health and metabolic disease.

nphi.title: EU CBRN CoE Project 045 – EUWAM-Lab mobile laboratory for viral haemorrhagic fever outbreaks in West Africa
nphi.with: Expertise France; Fondation Mérieux; INSERM
nphi.summary: EU-funded project with Institut Pasteur and French partners that deployed a mobile laboratory and trained staff to detect risk-group-4 viruses in Ebola-affected West African countries.

nphi.title: InVS–Togo mentorship, scientific-writing training and research protocols
nphi.with: INH Togo; University of Lomé; National Blood Transfusion Center Lomé
nphi.summary: InVS mentored the INH Togo director under the IANPHI/Heymann mentorship programme. In April 2013 it trained 19 West African scientists in scientific writing, using cases from Togo and Côte d'Ivoire, and supported five Togolese research…

nphi.title: IANPHI seed and short-term grants to NIMR, UVRI and INSP Côte d'Ivoire
nphi.with: Nigerian Institute of Medical Research; Uganda Virus Research Institute; INSP Côte d'Ivoire; University of Washington
nphi.summary: 2011 IANPHI grants funded research by NIMR (perinatal care) and UVRI (Aedes vector ecology; research-to-policy communication) and HIV/STD research training of INSP Côte d'Ivoire faculty at the University of Washington.
